name: Linear
description: Create, search and update Linear issues, browse projects, cycles, documents and custom views, and see Linear notifications in the menu bar.
author: thomaslombart

preferences.name: primaryAction
preferences.title: Primary Action
preferences.description: Select the action that runs when pressing Enter on an issue, project, document, or view in a list.

preferences.name: issueCustomCopyAction
preferences.title: Issue Custom Copy Action

preferences.name: limit
preferences.title: API Issue Limit
preferences.description: The maximum number of issues to fetch from the Linear API at once. Be careful when changing this, as too large a number can cause you to exceed your API rate limit and/or cause heap memory errors.

preferences.name: labelsLimit
preferences.title: API Label Limit
preferences.description: The maximum number of labels to fetch from the Linear API per team. Increase this value if some labels are missing when creating or editing issues.

preferences.name: shouldHideRedundantIssues
preferences.title: Advanced
preferences.label: Hide Redundant Issues
preferences.description: When enabled, the issues that are marked as Done, Canceled or Duplicate will not show up in search results.

preferences.name: linearApiKey
preferences.title: Linear Personal API Key
preferences.description: Create a personal API key in Linear Settings under Security & Access. The key controls which teams and actions are available.

preferences.label: Group notifications like Linear
preferences.name: groupNotifications
preferences.description: Show and count notification groups from your Linear inbox. Opening or marking a group as read applies to the whole group.

preferences.label: Always Show
preferences.name: alwaysShow
preferences.description: Show the menu bar extra even when you don't have any unread notifications.

commands.name: create-issue-for-myself
commands.title: Create Issue for Myself
commands.description: Create and assign a new issue to yourself.

preferences.name: preferredTeamKey
preferences.title: Preferred Team
preferences.description: Specify the Key (e.g. RAY) of the preferred team. If not specified, the first team is used.

preferences.name: preferredStatusName
preferences.title: Preferred Status
preferences.description: Specify the name of the preferred status for new issues (e.g. Todo, Backlog). If not specified, uses Linear's default.

preferences.name: shouldCloseMainWindow

preferences.label: Close window immediately
preferences.description: When enabled, the Raycast window is closed immediately, allowing you to carry on with other work.
